result.title: Extraction meets Distillation - cryptanalytic techniques to recover parameters from a Deep Neural Network
result.summary: We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels. We adapt a ReLU extraction implementation to Leaky ReLU, compare sign-search methods, and estimate biases and output layers. We prove conditional bounds for direction recovery with approximate prefixes, preservation of local distance votes, prediction changes from aligned parameter errors, and sign selection with independent scoring data. We also specify exact row restoration and distinguish its guarantee from that of gradient masking. The experiments evaluate assisted extraction, with privileged access to gradients, hidden activations, and victim parameters, followed by label-based reconstruction. Across eight search seeds on the largest synthetic architecture, Leaky ReLU recovers 51--57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer, while ReLU recovers none. This advantage does not hold uniformly across architectures and layers. Removing victim-weight access from the sign walk gives less accurate signs, despite high final prediction agreement. Across 40 seeded runs on the two smallest synthetic victims, agreement on 5,000 inputs excluded from fitting and selection ranges from $0.9890$ to $0.9992$. On two CIFAR-10 victims, the reconstructed models achieve $56.40\%$ and $58.29\%$ agreement and exceed the distillation baseline on three functional metrics. We report label requests separately from privileged access and explain why prediction agreement does not identify network parameters.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将密码分析的权重方向抽取与基于预测标签的学习结合，用于重建全连接网络：把 ReLU 抽取适配到 Leaky ReLU，比较符号搜索方法并估计偏置与输出层，给出方向恢复、预测一致性与符号选择的若干条件性界，并在合成架构与 CIFAR-10 上评估重建效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关于「预测一致并不识别内部参数」及参数误差对齐如何改变预测的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的因果贡献与可辨识性评价提供一种形式化视角，可供核查。
